author: Ubisoft YouTube
text:
The Division 2: Spearfall Season Launch Livestream
Join us live for the launch of Tom Clancy's The Division 2 Year 8 Season 4: Spearfall!

We'll go through what's coming, answer your questions and get ready to jump in together.

📅 November 25, 4 PM CET / 10 AM ET / 7 AM PT
💬 Live Q&A: join the chat and ask the team

Spearfall launches November 26, 2026.

About The Division 2:
Tom Clancy's The Division 2 is a shooter RPG with a thrilling campaign fully playable in co-op and multiple PVP modes.

In The Division 2, save your country in Washington, DC, and in the Warlords of New York expansion, hunt down Aaron Keener, a former Agent who has taken control of New York.
